newsitem.title: UK: Nationwide says will wait and see on rates.
newsitem.headline: Nationwide says will wait and see on rates.

text.p: Britain's Nationwide Building Society said on Friday it would take no action on home lending rates and review market reaction after the Bank of England raised official interest rates by a quarter of a percentage point.
"We will see what the rest of the market does and we will be maintaining our competitive position," a spokeswoman said.
Nationwide, Britain's biggest remaining mutually-owned building society, said its mortgage base rate was currently at 7.35 percent.
The Nationwide has pledged in the past to keep its home loan rates below those of building societies which have converted to bank status, such as Halifax Plc.
